note: QSL-1747 / FR-322 "Temporal clock bindings": filament.temporal.timed/v1 has two cases. A timed-model subject has no ClockConfiguration row and takes its time binding from the checked timed_model/time_source graph; its clock_name is model-time. A trace subject has exactly one `timed` row per occurrence whose clock_name is the clause's clock role and whose clock is {kind: timed, unit} (FR-540); its time-stamped positions and admitted order stay runtime inputs (FR-541). `subject` is `model` or `trace`; `row` is the clause's temporal_bindings row without its declaration key, or null for none.
